# Command reference

138 commands. Every user action is a command: the menus, the CLI (`forge cmd`), RPC (`command.run`), MCP (one tool per command, name with `.` replaced by `_`) and scripts (`run(id, #{...})`) all run the same handlers. Angles are degrees, percentages as shown, node ids are integers.

## `object`

### `object.create`

Create. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | Node type id, e.g. `forge.cube`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.create --args '{"type":"forge.cube"}'`

### `object.delete`

Delete. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Node ids; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.delete --args '{"nodes":[1]}'`

### `object.rename`

Rename. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.rename --args '{"name":"Box","node":1}'`

### `object.reparent`

Move. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `parent` | integer or null | no | New parent; null moves to the root level. Appended as the last child. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.reparent --args '{"node":2,"parent":1}'`

### `object.move`

Move Objects. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | integer or null | no | Position among the parent's children without the moved nodes; absent = last. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to move; the current selection when absent. |
| `parent` | integer or null | no | New parent; null or absent moves to the root level. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.move --args '{"index":0,"nodes":[2,3],"parent":1}'`

### `object.group`

Group Objects. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null | no | Name of the new group (default "Null"). |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to group; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.group --args '{"name":"Group","nodes":[2,3]}'`

### `object.create_cloner`

Create Cloner from Selection. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null | no | Name of the new cloner (default: the type's name). |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Objects that become the cloner's children; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.create_cloner --args '{"name":"Cloner","nodes":[2,3]}'`

### `object.visibility`

Visibility. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `editor` | `"on"` \| `"off"` \| string \| null | no | Editor (viewport) visibility. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to change; the current selection when absent. |
| `render` | `"on"` \| `"off"` \| string \| null | no | Render visibility. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.visibility --args '{"editor":"off","nodes":[1],"render":"default"}'`

### `object.enable`

Enable. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to change; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.enable --args '{"enabled":false,"nodes":[1]}'`

### `object.begin_rename`

Rename Active. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.begin_rename --args '{}'`

### `object.duplicate`

Duplicate. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `copies` | integer | no | Default: `1`. |
| `mode` | `"step"` \| `"total"` | no | Default: `"step"`. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to work on; the current selection when absent. |
| `offset` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`. |
| `rotation_deg` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`. |
| `scale` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[1.0,1.0,1.0]`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.duplicate --args '{"copies":2,"nodes":[1],"offset":[200.0,0.0,0.0]}'`

### `object.arrange`

Arrange. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | integer | no | Default: `3`. |
| `mode` | `"line"` \| `"grid"` \| `"circle"` | no | Default: `"line"`. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to work on; the current selection when absent. |
| `plane` | `"xz"` \| `"xy"` \| `"zy"` | no | Default: `"xz"`. |
| `radius` | number | no | Default: `200.0`. |
| `row_spacing` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[0.0,0.0,200.0]`. |
| `spacing` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[200.0,0.0,0.0]`. |
| `start_angle_deg` | number | no | Default: `0.0`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.arrange --args '{"mode":"line","nodes":[1,2],"spacing":[200.0,0.0,0.0]}'`

### `object.randomize`

Randomize. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to work on; the current selection when absent. |
| `position` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[50.0,50.0,50.0]`. |
| `rotation_deg` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`. |
| `scale` | array of number (length 3) | no | Default: `[0.0,0.0,0.0]`. |
| `seed` | integer | no | Default: `1`. |
| `uniform_scale` | boolean | no | Default: `false`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.randomize --args '{"nodes":[1],"position":[50.0,50.0,50.0],"seed":7}'`

### `object.transfer`

Transfer. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | boolean | no | Default: `true`. |
| `rotation` | boolean | no | Default: `true`. |
| `scale` | boolean | no | Default: `true`. |
| `source` | integer or null | no | Node to copy from; the active node when absent. |
| `space` | `"world"` \| `"local"` | no | Default: `"world"`. |
| `target` | integer | no | Default: `-1`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.transfer --args '{"source":1,"space":"world","target":2}'`

### `object.set_axis`

Set Axis. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer or null | no | The object; the active node when absent. |
| `pos` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | New axis position `[x, y, z]`. |
| `rot` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | New axis rotation `[h, p, b]` in degrees. |
| `scale` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | New axis scale `[x, y, z]` (always the object's own scale). |
| `space` | string \| string \| null | no | Whether `pos` and `rot` are local (default) or world values. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.set_axis --args '{"pos":[0.0,50.0,0.0],"space":"world"}'`

### `object.center_axis`

Center Axis. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Objects; the current selection when absent. |
| `to` | string \| string \| string \| string \| null | no | What to centre on (default `bounding_box`). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.center_axis --args '{"to":"bounding_box"}'`

### `object.align_axis`

Align Axis. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string \| string \| string | yes |  |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Objects; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.align_axis --args '{"to":"world"}'`


## `view`

### `view.clone_display`

Clone Display. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axes` | boolean or null | no | Show the axes of each clone of the selected cloners. |
| `indices` | boolean or null | no | Show the index of each clone of the selected cloners. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.clone_display --args '{"axes":false,"indices":true}'`

### `view.shading`

Shading. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"smooth"` \| `"flat"` \| `"wire"` \| `"smooth_wire"` \| `"flat_wire"` \| `"quick"` \| `"constant"` \| `"hidden_line"` \| `"bounding_box"` | yes | Viewport shading (mirrors the viewport's `Shading`). |
| `pane` | `"perspective"` \| `"top"` \| `"front"` \| `"right"` \| null | no | Viewport pane; absent = the active pane. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.shading --args '{"mode":"smooth_wire"}'`

### `view.layout`

Viewport Layout. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | `"single"` \| `"four"` \| null | no | `single` or `four`; absent toggles. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.layout --args '{"layout":"four"}'`

### `view.maximize`

Maximize Pane. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pane` | `"perspective"` \| `"top"` \| `"front"` \| `"right"` \| null | no | Viewport pane; absent = the active pane. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.maximize --args '{"pane":"top"}'`

### `view.lighting`

Viewport Lighting. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"headlight"` \| `"rig"` | yes | `view.lighting`: the lights the viewport shades with (docs/specs/VIEWPORT.md §8.1). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.lighting --args '{"mode":"rig"}'`

### `view.shadows`

Viewport Shadows. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.shadows --args '{"enabled":true}'`

### `view.antialias`

Viewport Anti-aliasing. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.antialias --args '{"enabled":true}'`

Gizmo Mode. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"move"` \| `"rotate"` \| `"scale"` | yes | The viewport gizmo's mode (mirrors the viewport's `GizmoMode`). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.gizmo_mode --args '{"mode":"move"}'`

### `view.gizmo_space`

Gizmo Space. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `space` | `"object"` \| `"world"` \| null | no | `object` or `world`; absent toggles. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.gizmo_space --args '{"space":"world"}'`

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.frame_all --args '{}'`

Frame Selected. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.frame_selected --args '{}'`

### `view.set_view`

Set View. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view` | `"perspective"` \| `"front"` \| `"back"` \| `"left"` \| `"right"` \| `"top"` \| `"bottom"` | yes | A named camera view (`view.set_view`; mirrors the viewport's `StandardView`). |
| `pane` | `"perspective"` \| `"top"` \| `"front"` \| `"right"` \| null | no | Viewport pane; absent = the active pane. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge view.set_view --args '{"view":"top"}'`

### `view.set_camera`

Set Camera. Not an undoable edit.

The fields `view.set_camera` may change; absent fields are kept.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `distance` | number or null | no | Pivot to eye distance, greater than 0. |
| `fov` | number or null | no | Vertical field of view in degrees, between 1 and 170 (perspective). |
| `height` | number or null | no | Visible world height, greater than 0 (orthographic). |
| `pitch` | number or null | no | Display-space pitch in degrees (clamped just short of straight up/down). |
| `projection` | `"perspective"` \| `"orthographic"` \| null | no |  |
| `target` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Pivot point in world coordinates. |
| `yaw` | number or null | no | Display-space yaw in degrees. |

## `transform`

### `transform.set`

Set Transform. One undo step.

| `scale` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Scale `[x, y, z]`. |

### `transform.edit`

Set Coordinates. One undo step.

|---|---|---|---|
| `gesture` | integer or null | no | Edits with the same gesture number and nodes merge into one undo step. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Objects to edit; absent means the current selection. |
| `pos` | array of number or null (length 3) or null | no | Position `[x, y, z]`; a `null` axis keeps the shown value. |
| `rot` | array of number or null (length 3) or null | no | Rotation `[h, p, b]` in degrees; `null` keeps an axis. |
| `scale` | array of number or null (length 3) or null | no | Scale factors; `null` keeps an axis. Not together with `size`. |

| `space` | string or null | no | `local` (default) or `world`. |

| `polys` | array of integer or null | no | Polygons to cut (plane and line modes); all when absent. |
| `to` | array of number (length 3) | no | line mode: end of the drawn segment |
| `visible_only` | boolean | no | line mode: skip polygons facing away (default true). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.knife --args '{"mode":"plane","normal":[1.0,0.0,0.0],"point":[0.0,0.0,0.0]}'`

### `mesh.bridge`

Bridge. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edges` | array of integer \| array of integer (length 2) (length 2) or null | no | Two border edges (id or point pair); each stands for its whole border loop. Give edges or polys. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `polys` | array of integer (length 2) or null | no | Two polygons of the same size: they are removed and their outlines bridged. Give edges or polys. |
| `segments` | integer or null | no | Rows of quads between the loops (default 1). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.bridge --args '{"polys":[0,1],"segments":1}'`

### `mesh.close_hole`

Close Polygon Hole. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edge` | integer \| array of integer (length 2) | yes | Edge id of the mesh, or a point pair [a, b] of an existing edge. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.close_hole --args '{"edge":0}'`

### `mesh.stitch`

Stitch and Sew. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edges` | array of array of integer \| array of integer (length 2) (length 2) or null | no | Pairs of border edges [e1, e2] (id or point pair) to sew together. Give points or edges. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `points` | array of array of integer (length 2) or null | no | Point pairs [a, b] to merge (into the lowest index of each set). Give points or edges. |
| `position` | `"middle"` \| `"first"` \| `null` | no | Where merged points go (default middle). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.stitch --args '{"points":[[0,1]],"position":"middle"}'`

### `mesh.pen`

Polygon Pen. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `corners` | array of object \| object | yes | One corner adds a point, three or more add a polygon. A corner is {point: index} (an existing point) or {pos: [x, y, z]} (a new point, object space). |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.pen --args '{"corners":[{"pos":[0.0,0.0,0.0]},{"pos":[1.0,0.0,0.0]},{"pos":[0.0,1.0,0.0]}]}'`

### `mesh.transform`

Transform Components. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gesture` | integer or null | no | Steps with the same gesture number and objects merge into one undo step (a dragged Coordinates field). |
| `move` | array of number (length 3) | no | Translation in object space. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Polygon objects transformed together in one undo step; every selected polygon object when node and nodes are absent (EDITABLE.md section 6.4). |
| `pivot` | array of number (length 3) | no | Pivot, object space; the mean of the selected points when absent. |
| `points` | array of integer or null | no | Point ids (one object only); the stored selection of the current mode (points, points of the edges or of the polygons) when absent. |
| `rotate` | object | no | Rotation about the pivot, angle in degrees. |
| `scale` | number \| array of number (length 3) | no | Scale about the pivot: one number or [x, y, z]. |
| `soft` | boolean \| object | no | false: off, true: on with the editor settings, object: on with these values over the editor settings. Absent: the editor setting. |
| `space` | `"object"` \| `"world"` \| `null` | no | object: the arguments are in each object's object space (default for one object); world: in world space, one pivot for all objects (default for several). |
| `symmetry` | boolean \| object | no | As soft, for the symmetry plane. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.transform --args '{"move":[0.0,10.0,0.0],"points":[0],"soft":{"falloff":"bell","radius":100.0},"symmetry":{"axis":"x"}}'`

## `param`

### `param.set`

Set Parameter. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `param` | string | yes | Parameter id. |
| `value` | any | yes | Bool, number, `[x, y, z]`, string, node id or null, or an array of indices. Angles are degrees and percentages are as shown (50 is 50 %). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge param.set --args '{"node":1,"param":"size","value":2.5}'`

### `param.edit`

Edit Parameter. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `param` | string | yes | Parameter id. |
| `value` | any | yes | As for `param.set` (degrees, percent as shown). With `component`, one number. |
| `component` | integer or null | no | Vec3 parameters only: set just this component (0, 1, 2) and keep the others of each object. |
| `gesture` | integer or null | no | Edits with the same gesture number merge into one undo step (a scrub or colour drag). |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Objects to edit; absent means the current selection. Objects whose type lacks the parameter (or has it with another kind) are skipped. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge param.edit --args '{"gesture":1,"nodes":[1],"param":"size","value":2.5}'`

## `graph`

### `graph.add_node`

Add Graph Node. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | integer | yes | The expression tag that owns the graph. |
| `type` | string | yes | Node type id, e.g. `math.add` (see `graph.node_types`). |
| `pos` | array of number (length 2) or null | no | Editor position `[x, y]` of the new node. |
| `values` | object or null | no | Constants of unconnected inputs by port id. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge graph.add_node --args '{"pos":[40.0,80.0],"tag":1,"type":"math.add","values":{"b":2.0}}'`

### `graph.remove`

Remove Graph Node. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | integer | yes |  |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Graph node id. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Several graph node ids, removed in one undo step. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge graph.remove --args '{"nodes":[1,2],"tag":1}'`

### `graph.connect`

Connect Graph Ports. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | integer | yes |  |
| `from_node` | integer | yes |  |
| `from_port` | string | yes | Output port id. |
| `to_node` | integer | yes |  |
| `to_port` | string | yes | Input port id. |
| `release_node` | integer or null | no | An input whose link is removed in the same step (moving a link between inputs). |
| `release_port` | string or null | no |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge graph.connect --args '{"from_node":1,"from_port":"out","release_node":2,"release_port":"b","tag":1,"to_node":2,"to_port":"a"}'`

### `graph.disconnect`

Disconnect Graph Port. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | integer | yes |  |
| `to_node` | integer | yes |  |
| `to_port` | string | yes |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge graph.disconnect --args '{"tag":1,"to_node":2,"to_port":"a"}'`

### `graph.set_value`

Set Graph Value. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | integer | yes |  |
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
